pitch:
# Kanban Board

## 1. People and their journey

**Team member** is the only role. Every member has the same abilities.

- **Needs to see:** every column in order, every card in each column, and who is assigned to each card.
- **Decides:** what work to add, which stage it is in, and who takes it.
- **Path:**
  1. Opens the board, which loads ready to use.
  2. Scans the columns.
  3. Adds a card to the first column.
  4. Opens a card to write its description and assign members.
  5. Drags cards rightward as the work progresses.
  6. Leaves when the board matches reality.
- **Occasionally:** adds, renames, reorders or deletes columns, and adds teammates.

## 2. How it looks

The Kanban Board looks like a familiar card board, like a corkboard of index cards:

- A coloured backdrop with a bar along the top.
- A row of grey vertical lanes running left to right, one lane per stage, each headed by its name.
- Inside each lane, a stack of white rounded cards.
- On each card, its title and small round initial badges for the people doing it.
- When the lanes overflow the window, the row of lanes scrolls sideways.

The parts, in order:

- **Backdrop:** full-page flat deep blue (#0B5394) behind everything.
- **Top bar:** full-width strip across the top, translucent darker blue, flat. Shows the board name in white bold text at left. Shows the team's member badges and a white "Team" button at right.
- **Board name:** white bold text in the top bar. While being edited, it becomes a white outlined text box with dark text.
- **Member badge:** 28px circle in the member's chosen colour, showing white initials. The available colours are red, orange, amber, green, teal, blue, purple and pink.
- **Team panel:** white raised, shadowed panel that drops below the "Team" button. Lists each member's badge and name, a remove "×" beside each member, and an "Add member" field.
- **Lane area:** sits below the top bar, flat and transparent over the backdrop. Lanes sit 12px apart and the area scrolls sideways when full.
- **Column:** 272px wide, light grey (#EBECF0), rounded, flat. Its height grows with its cards, then the column scrolls internally.
  - While dragged: tilted slightly, shadowed, semi-transparent.
  - Its gap is shown as a darker grey slot.
- **Column header:** bold dark grey name at the top of the column, with a grey count of cards beside it and a "⋯" menu button at the right.
  - While renaming, the name becomes an outlined text box.
- **Column menu:** white shadowed popover with three items: "Rename", "Move left", "Move right" and "Delete column".
  - Delete is shown in red.
  - Move left is greyed and unavailable in the first column. Move right is greyed and unavailable in the last column.
- **Card:** white, rounded, with a light shadow. Shows the title in dark text, a "≡" mark if a description exists, and assignee badges at the bottom right.
  - On hover: light grey.
  - While dragged: tilted and with a deeper shadow.
- **Drop slot:** a darker grey card-sized gap that appears where a dragged card will land.
- **Add-card link:** grey "+ Add a card" text at the bottom of each column.
  - On hover: darker grey background.
  - When clicked, it becomes a white text box with a green "Add card" button and a "×" button.
- **Add-column tile:** translucent white lane at the end of the row, reading "+ Add another column" in white.
  - When clicked, it becomes a name box with a green "Add column" button.
- **Card window:** centred white shadowed dialog over a dimmed backdrop. It contains:
  - an editable title;
  - the current column name;
  - a description box;
  - an assignee list with checkboxes;
  - a red "Delete card" button;
  - a "×" close button.
- **Confirm prompt:** small white dialog asking "Delete this column and its N cards?" or "Delete this card?". Has a red "Delete" button and a grey "Cancel" button.
- **Empty column:** shows only its header and the add-card link.

## 3. How it is used

**Cards**
- **Add a card:** click "+ Add a card", type a title, then press Enter or click "Add card". The card joins the column's bottom and the box stays open for the next card. Press Esc to cancel.
- **Move a card:** with a mouse, drag the card to any position in any column. With a finger, long-press the card, then drag. The other cards shift to show the drop slot. Releasing places the card there.
- **Cancel a drag:** release the card outside every column, or press Esc. The card returns to its original place.
- **Open a card:** click or tap it to open the card window.
- **Edit a card title:** click the title in the card window, type, then press Enter or click away to save. An empty title restores the previous title.
- **Edit a description:** click the description box, type, then click away to save.
- **Assign members:** tick or untick members in the card window. Their badges appear on or disappear from the card immediately.
- **Close the card window:** click "×", click the dimmed backdrop, or press Esc.
- **Delete a card:** click "Delete card", then confirm. The card disappears.

**Columns**
- **Add a column:** click "+ Add another column", type a name, then press Enter. The column appears last.
- **Rename a column:** double-click the column name, or choose "Rename" from the column menu. Type, then press Enter to save. Press Esc to cancel.
- **Reorder columns:** drag a column by its header. With a finger, long-press the header, then drag. You can also choose "Move left" or "Move right" from the column menu.
- **Delete a column:** choose "Delete column" from the column menu, then confirm. The column and all its cards are removed.

**Board and team**
- **Rename the board:** click the board name, type, then press Enter.
- **Manage the team:**
  - Click "Team" to open the team panel.
  - To add a member, type a name, pick a colour, then press Enter.
  - To remove a member, click "×" beside them, then confirm.
  - Click outside the panel to close it.

## 4. Scope

The loop: add cards, describe them, assign members, and move them through columns until they are done.

The board starts with three columns: To Do, In Progress and Done. Columns can be added, renamed, reordered and deleted.

Each form asks only for what is needed:
- a card asks for its title;
- a column asks for its name;
- a member asks for a name and a colour.

There is one board per team. All members see changes on the board.

## 5. Things and their states

- **Board:** holds a name, its ordered columns and the team's members. It is always active.
- **Column:** holds a name and a position. It moves from created, to renamed or moved any number of times, to deleted. Deleting it removes its cards.
- **Card:** holds a title, a description, its column, its position within the column and its assignees. It moves from created (at the bottom of a column), to moved or edited, to deleted.
- **Member:** holds a name, initials and a colour. It moves from added to removed. Removing a member unassigns them from every card.

## 6. Rules

**Cards**
- A card's title must contain at least one non-space character. Adding a blank title is ignored and nothing changes.
- Titles are limited to 200 characters and descriptions to 5,000 characters. Typing beyond the limit is ignored.
- A card belongs to exactly one column at one position.
- Dropping a card renumbers the positions in both the source and target columns with no gaps.
- Dropping a card outside every column returns it unchanged.
- A card may have zero or more assignees, each a current member, and each listed at most once.
- Deleting a card requires confirmation. Cancelling changes nothing.

**Columns**
- A column name must be non-blank and at most 40 characters. A blank rename restores the old name.
- Column names may repeat.
- The board must keep at least one column. Delete is unavailable on the last remaining column.
- Deleting a column requires confirmation and deletes all its cards.
- Moving the first column left, or the last column right, is unavailable.

**Members**
- A member name must be non-blank. Initials are the first letters of the first two words of the name.
- Adding a member whose name exactly matches an existing member's name is refused, with "Already on the team" shown below the field.
- Removing a member requires confirmation and clears their assignments from every card.

**Board**
- A board name must be non-blank. A blank rename restores the old name.
- Every change is saved immediately and appears for all members without reloading.

action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Board loads ready to use] (Board): Given a team member opens the board When the board loads Then every column is shown in order with its cards, assignees and members
- [Add card with non-blank title] (Board): Given the add-card box is open in a column When a member enters a title with at least one non-space character and confirms Then a card is created at the bottom of that column and the box stays open
- [Blank card title ignored] (Board): Given the add-card box is open When a member confirms a title containing only spaces Then no card is created and the board is unchanged
- [Card title length limit] (Board): Given a card title of 200 characters When a member types one more character Then the extra character is ignored and the title stays at 200 characters
- [Card description length limit] (Board): Given a description of 5,000 characters When a member types one more character Then the extra character is ignored and the description stays at 5,000 characters
- [Card belongs to exactly one column and position] (Board): Given a card exists on the board When any change to its placement is saved Then the card references exactly one column and one position within it
- [Move card to any position in any column] (Board): Given a card in column A When a member drags it and releases it at a position in column B Then the card is placed at that position in column B and the other cards shift
- [Renumber positions with no gaps after drop] (Board): Given columns A and B with cards at contiguous positions When a card is moved from A to B Then positions in A and B are renumbered consecutively starting at the first position with no gaps
- [Drop outside every column returns card unchanged] (Board): Given a card is being dragged from its original position When it is released outside every column or Esc is pressed Then the card returns to its original column and position and no positions change
- [Edit card title with blank restore] (Board): Given a card with title T When a member clears the title and saves Then the title reverts to T
- [Edit card description] (Board): Given a card window is open When a member types a description and clicks away Then the description is saved on the card
- [Assign members to card] (Board): Given a card and a current member When the member is ticked in the card window Then the member is assigned once to the card and their badge appears on it
- [Unassign member from card] (Board): Given a member is assigned to a card When the member is unticked in the card window Then the member is no longer assigned to the card
- [Delete card requires confirmation] (Board): Given a card window is open When a member clicks Delete card and then cancels the prompt Then the card remains unchanged
- [Confirmed card deletion] (Board): Given a card in column A at position 2 When a member confirms deletion Then the card is removed and the cards after it in column A are renumbered without gaps
- [Add column with non-blank name] (Board): Given the add-column tile is open When a member enters a valid name and presses Enter Then a column is created at the last position
- [Column name length and blank rules] (Board): Given a column name of 40 characters When a member types one more character Then the extra character is ignored; and Given a blank name When it is submitted Then no column is created
- [Column names may repeat] (Board): Given a column named To Do exists When a member adds another column named To Do Then the new column is created
- [Rename column] (Board): Given a column named A When a member renames it to B and presses Enter Then the column is named B; and When the member presses Esc instead Then it stays A
- [Blank column rename restores old name] (Board): Given a column named A When a member saves a blank name Then the column name remains A
- [Reorder column by drag or menu] (Board): Given columns A, B, C in that order When column B is moved left Then the order becomes B, A, C with positions renumbered consecutively
- [Move left and right boundaries] (Board): Given the first column When a member requests Move left Then nothing changes; and Given the last column When a member requests Move right Then nothing changes
- [Delete column requires confirmation and removes its cards] (Board): Given a column with 3 cards When a member deletes it and confirms Then the column and its 3 cards are removed and the remaining columns keep their order
- [Board keeps at least one column] (Board): Given the board has exactly one column When a member requests to delete it Then the deletion is refused and the column remains
- [Cancelling column deletion changes nothing] (Board): Given the delete column confirmation is shown When a member cancels Then the column and its cards are unchanged
- [Add member with non-blank name] (Board): Given the team panel is open When a member enters a non-blank name, picks a colour and presses Enter Then the member is added with initials derived from the name
- [Member initials derivation] (Board): Given a member name Ada Lovelace Byron When the member is added Then initials are AL
- [Duplicate member name refused] (Board): Given a member named Sam exists When a member adds another member named Sam Then the addition is refused and the message Already on the team is shown below the field
- [Remove member requires confirmation and clears assignments] (Board): Given a member assigned to three cards When a member removes them and confirms Then the member is deleted and absent from all three cards' assignees
- [Non-blank board name] (Board): Given a board named X When a member renames it to blank Then the name remains X; and When renamed to Y Then the name is Y
- [Changes saved immediately for all members] (Board): Given two members view the board When one member changes a card or column Then the other member sees the change without reloading
- [Column menu availability] (Board): Given the first column of three When its menu is opened Then Move left is greyed out and unavailable while Move right is available
- [Board visual layout] (Board): Given the board is displayed with more columns than fit the window When it renders Then columns are 272px wide, spaced 12px apart and the row scrolls sideways
- [Card visual states] (Board): Given a card has a description and two assignees When it is displayed Then it shows the title, the description mark and two badges at bottom right
- [Member badge colours] (Board): Given a member chose colour teal When their badge is displayed Then it is a 28px teal circle with white initials
intent_block:
- Product type: internal_tool
- Audience: members of a small team tracking their shared work
- Goal: Let the team see what work exists, what stage each item is in, and who is doing it, by moving cards across columns on a board.
- Scope: A single kanban board per team, made of ordered columns containing cards that team members create, edit, assign, and move between columns.
- The model must cover: boards and their ordered columns (workflow stages); cards representing work items, with title and description; team members and card assignment; card position and movement between columns
- Do NOT model: customer or external user access; billing or subscription management; reporting or analytics dashboards; integrations with other tools
